notes.title: Join the Aura Discord
notes.notes:
Aura now has a Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/vCmFNUKkKG

Feel free to join it to get help, request features or discuss with others or myself.

notes.title: Desktop Wallpapers fixed for all Windows versions
notes.notes:
Desktop Wallpapers should now display correctly on all Windows versions.

If you still experience any issues, feel free to comment here.

notes.title: Lockscreen Wallpapers can now launch before login
notes.notes: There is now an option in the settings to make lockscreen wallpapers start right when the PC boots, before the first login.

notes.title: Selecting videos has been fixed
notes.notes:
There was an issue that prevented selecting videos. This issue has now been resolved.
Make sure to close Aura for the Steam update to succeed.

notes.title: Experimental Desktop Wallpaper Support
notes.notes: Support for desktop wallpapers was enabled. It is still experimental. So bugs are to be expected.
